subject: manual chapter on clustering (with soft K-means example)

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: manual chapter on clustering (with soft K-means example)
parts:
(Oops -- sent this to stan-dev first by mistake.)

I wrote up the section for the manual on soft K-means
and put the relevant pages up on our downloads page:

http://stan.googlecode.com/files/stan-reference-clustering.pdf

Please pay particular attention to the problems for Bayesian
inference posed by clustering section (a toxic combination of
non-identifiability and multimodality).

You can also find the model, an R program to generate
simulated data, and an example of simulated data in
our repository. You can get the relevant files for
soft-k-means here:

http://code.google.com/p/stan/source/browse/#git%2Fsrc%2Fmodels%2Fmisc%2Fcluster%2Fsoft-k-means

I'll add LDA next, but please please read the problems section
before you decide using MCMC for clustering is the way you
want to go.

- Bob
